context_for_next_testing_agent: Fuzzy search autocomplete working with typo correction. The fuzzywuzzy library returns tuples of varying lengths (2 or 3 elements), and the fix handles both cases safely. SmartSearch cache is loaded once at startup via singleton pattern. Admin badge APIs (/api/admin/sellers, /api/admin/sellers/{id}/badge) require dev-test-token for authentication. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_fuzzy_search_and_badges.py
rca_of_the_issue: Original fuzzy search error 'not enough values to unpack (expected 3, got 2)' was caused by fuzzywuzzy library returning 2-value tuples (match, score) instead of 3-value tuples (match, score, index). Fix implemented safe unpacking that handles both formats.
